title: Check the V45 rank-7 intersection and its declared subset margins
body:
## Summary
- The listed basis `⟨256, 128, 64, 35, 16, 11, 5⟩` spans `E_7 ∩ E_42 ∩ E_45`. The normals satisfy `7 XOR 42 = 45`, so the intersection has rank 7.
- In the declared price table, every proper subset of helpers 249, 251, 265 and 267 has a negative margin. The full group has margin `+22972`. Dropping any one helper costs exactly `25371`.
- The selected kappa is unchanged. The literal word, cleanup, chronology and supplier caps are not replayed.
